Record Class HealthCheckProber.Settings

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.http.client.loadbalance.HealthCheckProber.Settings
Record Components:
interval - The interval between two rounds
jitter - The fraction of the interval by which it is spread either way, from 0 to 1
timeout - How long a probe may take before it fails
concurrency - The maximum number of probes of a round at once
healthyThreshold - The consecutive successful probes that make an unhealthy instance healthy
unhealthyThreshold - The consecutive failed probes that make a healthy instance unhealthy
Enclosing class:
HealthCheckProber
public static record HealthCheckProber.Settings(Duration interval, double jitter, Duration timeout, int concurrency, int healthyThreshold, int unhealthyThreshold) extends Record
The settings of the health check.

    static HealthCheckProber.Settings
    of(Duration interval)
    The settings of a health check at the given interval: a probe fails after the interval or after 10 seconds, whichever is shorter; one failed probe makes an instance unhealthy and one successful probe healthy again, as the health check of a configured service always did; at most 8 probes run at once; each interval is spread by up to 10% either way.
